_doc: Where each character's harvest trips start and end (docs/LUMBER_LOOP.md §3; harness/home.py). The way home is the character's own book's default rune, which lands at `landing` (facet `facet`); from there the house steward or innkeeper takes it into the rental room `room` (owner words for the room menu's Visit Other Rooms row; empty = the character's own room), on facet `room.facet`, where the boards go into the secure container `chest` (within reach of `room.arrival`). `library` is the rune library at home (places.py; the Cambria library is public and always usable). Live values: docs/NOTES.md 'Rental room via the DTF house steward' (2026-10-04).
